name: Codename Seconds #0
source:
You wake up in your room like always, white walls surround you, it's peaceful here, but the clock stopped working. Your not sure your going to be okay unless the clock starts working again soon. Luckily there are others here to help you.

[From [url=https://thecrimsonnight.itch.io/codename-seconds-0]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你像往常一样在房间里醒来，白色的墙壁包围着你，这里很安静，但时钟停止了工作。除非时钟很快重新开始工作，否则你不确定自己是否会好起来。幸运的是，这里还有其他人可以帮助你。

[来自[url=https://thecrimsonnight.itch.io/codename-seconds-0]Itch.io[/url]]
